scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the ten official Murders at Karlov Manor Magic Story episodes (2023-12-05 to 2024-01-18) and the Planeswalker's Guide to Murders at Karlov Manor. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

entities.name: Oba, the dryad of life (a face of Trostani)

Kaya circled the desk to Teysa's side, not letting herself touch the body again.
